map.幅宽利用率和裁床利用率区别？: What is the difference between width utilization and cutting-table utilization?
map.幅宽利用率看横向有效占比，裁床利用率看整匹面积中裁片净占比，后者更全面。: Width utilization looks at the effective proportion across the width, while cutting-table utilization looks at the net share of cut pieces in the whole piece area; the latter is more comprehensive.
map.有效幅宽怎么定？: How is the effective width determined?
map.布边、针孔、布疵区不可裁，有效幅宽 = 总幅宽减不可用边；按验布结果定。: Selvage, needle holes and fabric defects cannot be cut; effective width = total width minus unusable edges; determined from fabric inspection results.
